sources.title: Small-instanton transitions in F-theory

evidence.text: Split G into gauge-preserving Gh and factorized Ginst/(2π) = Σi aiΛ(i) ∧ F, with fundamental-weight divisors Λ(i) = (A⁻¹)ijEj. Orthogonality of Gh to Cartan divisors eliminates the cross term in the induced D3 charge.

sources.title: The frozen phase of heterotic F-theory duality

evidence.text: Construct frozen duals by contracting base curves to match tensor counts, replacing selected I* fibers by frozen assignments, and assigning gauge divisors using embedding indices. Apply the imported frozen Green–Schwarz rule K→K+F.

sources.title: Small instantons in string theory

evidence.text: Quantize DD and DN strings with five-brane Chan–Paton factors, including orientation and GSO projections. Extend from one to coincident five-branes and compare the predicted SO(N) instanton moduli space with the ADHM description reported in the paper.

sources.title: Evidence for heterotic / heterotic duality

evidence.text: Use membrane/fivebrane wrapping and reduction, flux quantization and worldvolume Bianchi identities, Weyl rescalings of compactification volumes, and index-theorem dimensions of instanton moduli spaces. Match candidate dual enhancement loci through codimensions and allowed Higgs representations.

sources.title: Comments on string dynamics in six-dimensions

evidence.text: Geometric descriptions use membranes stretched between five-branes and boundaries, and F-theory blow-ups or blow-downs. These descriptions motivate transitions that change instanton numbers or the number of tensor multiplets.

sources.title: Heterotic phase transitions and singularities of the gauge dyonic string

evidence.text: The authors solve the coupled bosonic equations with a warped string ansatz and self-dual transverse SU(2) instantons. The single-instanton profile is extended to multi-instantons and to instantons embedded in multiple gauge factors.

sources.title: Compactness of brane moduli and the String Lamppost Principle in d > 6

evidence.text: Can compactness, connectedness, and local field-theory data of small-instanton brane moduli reconstruct internal string geometries and establish the String Lamppost Principle for supersymmetric gravity in dimensions seven through nine, with an extension toward six dimensions?

sources.title: Small instantons and weak scale string theory

evidence.text: Can small-instanton gauge sectors support four-dimensional gauge interactions while the heterotic string scale is arbitrarily low, in weakly and strongly coupled descriptions? What possible roles do these sectors have in supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Point - like instantons and the spin (32) / Z(2) heterotic string

evidence.text: Classify heterotic compactifications on K3 preserving the full primordial Spin(32)/Z2 perturbative gauge symmetry, and determine the nonperturbative physics when point-like instantons occupy orbifold singularities or coalesce.

evidence.text: Substitute φ=u/a^(3/2) to remove the scalar-velocity term exactly. Then approximate the background by ΛCDM and expand the potential quadratically near its maximum, obtaining a constant-coefficient equation for u and an analytic solution normalized to w0.
